newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HOLEC HOLLAND GETS 9 MILLION GUILDER CHINESE ORDER.
newsitem.headline: HOLEC HOLLAND GETS 9 MILLION GUILDER CHINESE ORDER.

text.p: Dutch engineering group Holec Holland said on Wednesday it had booked a 9 million guilder order via its Chinese joint-venture. The order was placed by the energy company in Beijing. A big electrification project has been started in the region and the joint-venture is to deliver 162 switchboards for 10.000 volt installations.

Holec Holland's unit Holec Middenspanning BV had signed an agreement with China's Zhenjiang Electrical on September 11 to start a joint-venture in China for the production of medium voltage switch-gear systems.
Holec expects Chinese turnover on the Unitole-production line to outstrip its equivalent Dutch production in the near future.

Holec intends to ask for a bourse listing on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange at the end of 1998 and recently announced an operational profit of 30 million guilders for 1996, the company said. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
